items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 132:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the borrowing of the vessels of Leah by Rachel? It was explained above, in the adjacent [answer], that at night after midnight, Leah borrows the vessels of Rachel to her own authority. However, by day, after the illumination of the vessels of Rachel has already been completed at night, behold, Rachel again ascends to Atzilut with the nine points of additions that were joined to her in Beriah, which are the new NHY, as above in Answer 131. And then the coupling face-to-face with ZA is made in his entire stature, and it is found that "Rachel then borrows the vessels of Leah," for then also from the chest and above of ZA the aspect of revealed Hassadim is made, and therefore Leah is pushed out from there to the aspect of the back of ZA, since it is against her nature and inclination, for she is always in the secret of "for He delights in mercy," like the GAR of Ima. However, this too is discerned by the name of a borrowing for the hour, because it does not operate except at the time of the coupling alone. But after the coupling she again returns this place to Leah, and Rachel descends below the chest. (Item 33. Part 1, Page 505, s.v. "and with this").
